plugins.description: 3D asset production pipeline for Claude Code — from a text brief or a photo to an optimized, validated GLB. Scripted modeling measured against the photo, textures from CC0 scans (Poly Haven), AI generation (Hunyuan3D, local TRELLIS.2 templates), marketplace search (PolyHaven, Sketchfab), optimization and multi-format export, on both Blender MCP servers.
